transcript: Hi, it's Nikki Sixx. About 80% of people who use heroin first misuse prescription opioids. So let's stop the stigma and work towards recovery. It can start with a few easy words to join the movement and start a conversation. Find out more at findyourwords.org. Brought to you by Kaiser Permanente.
metadata_caption: Help Nikki Sixx fight stigma, raise awareness, and spread hope | Kaiser Permanente
